columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Editorial/search tags for study playlists and collections. Kept separate from video semantic tags.

columns.name: metadata
columns.comment: Editorial metadata for playlist scope, classification source, and future curation workflow state.

columns.name: review_status
columns.comment: Editorial taxonomy review status: needs_review, auto_reviewed, reviewed, or rejected.

columns.name: classification_confidence
columns.comment: 0-1 confidence for the current playlist taxonomy metadata.

tables.name: public.direct_messages
tables.comment: Private one-to-one messages between Tube O2 profiles. Client access goes through secure RPCs and participant-scoped realtime reads.

columns.name: full_name
columns.check: char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM full_name)) >= 2 AND char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM full_name)) <= 120

columns.name: email
columns.check: char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM email)) >= 6 AND char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM email)) <= 320

columns.name: confirmation_sent_at
columns.comment: Timestamp of the latest successful editor application confirmation email.

columns.name: confirmation_error
columns.comment: Latest transactional email error for the editor application confirmation flow.

columns.name: confirmation_provider_id
columns.comment: Provider message id returned by the transactional email service.

tables.name: public.video_submissions
tables.comment: Tracks asynchronous Tube O2 video submissions. /submit/status/:id uses video_submissions.id.

columns.name: duplicate_video_id
columns.comment: Existing video matched during duplicate detection, when available.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: Allowed states: pending, processing, success, failed, duplicate, recoverable_error.

columns.name: metadata
columns.comment: Small JSON payload for worker/frontend coordination, such as enrichmentId, detectedLanguage, and assignment result.

tables.name: public.video_transcripts
tables.comment: Internal transcript records generated during Tube O2 video processing. Full transcript text is not exposed to client roles.

columns.name: transcript_text
columns.comment: Full transcript text for internal processing and audit only.

columns.name: summary
columns.comment: Short public-safe summary exposed through v_video_exhibition.

tables.name: public.contact_messages
tables.comment: Internal Tube O2 contact form messages. Inserted by Edge Functions; not directly exposed to client roles.

columns.name: metadata
columns.comment: Provider ids, request ids, user agent, origin, and delivery diagnostics for contact messages.

tables.name: public.playlist_follows
tables.comment: Users following playlists to receive updates when new videos are added.

columns.name: notifications_enabled
columns.comment: When false, the user follows the playlist but does not receive playlist update notifications.

tables.name: public.playlist_editor_requests
tables.comment: Requests from authenticated users who want to become editors of an existing playlist.

columns.name: curricular_year
columns.check: curricular_year IS NULL OR curricular_year >= 1 AND curricular_year <= 8

columns.name: semester
columns.check: semester IS NULL OR semester >= 1 AND semester <= 3

columns.name: ects
columns.check: ects IS NULL OR ects > 0::numeric AND ects <= 90::numeric

columns.name: confidence
columns.check: confidence IS NULL OR confidence >= 0::numeric AND confidence <= 1::numeric

columns.name: confidence
columns.check: confidence IS NULL OR confidence >= 0::numeric AND confidence <= 1::numeric

columns.name: confidence
columns.check: confidence IS NULL OR confidence >= 0::numeric AND confidence <= 1::numeric

tables.name: public.video_analysis_jobs
tables.comment: Tracks optional deep video analysis separately from fast video_submissions completion.

columns.name: metadata
columns.comment: Operational metadata for the deep-analysis job. Must not store raw transcripts, secrets, emails, or private payloads.

tables.name: public.video_taxonomy_correction_audit
tables.comment: Append-only audit trail for Tube O2 taxonomy corrections. Stores old/new values and the editorial reason for every migration-driven change.

tables.name: public.edge_rate_limits
tables.comment: Server-side counters for per-user Edge Function rate limiting. Managed only by service-role Edge Functions.
